interview.name: Mina
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location are not specified in the notes.

reflections: Mina is proactive and supportive, offering practical help and following up to keep plans moving.
Uli is receptive to help and seems to rely on Mina for coordination and sorting tasks.
Hana is cooperative but cautious, preferring to confirm details before committing and keeping Mina updated.
Mina is the coordinator and often asks for the next concrete step or task list.
Hana is responsive but cautious, preferring to confirm details before committing.
Oren is willing to help with hands-on repairs but benefits from clear, immediate direction.
Mina is the central coordinator, repeatedly asking for the next task and offering help.
The group works in a practical, task-oriented way around a shared repair drive, with people taking specific fixes or sorting jobs.
Mina appears comfortable following up with different people and keeping the work moving across schedules and tools.
Mina is the main coordinator here, following up across repair, sorting, and coverage tasks and offering to take the first fix.
Noah is responsive but relies on Mina for clear starting details, suggesting he works best with a concrete handoff.
Jules and Opal are both keeping logistics moving by locking in schedules and locations before sending fuller details to the group.
Mina tends to take on coordination and next-step routing, especially when others are waiting for instructions.
Opal is still gathering location and coverage details before sharing, suggesting a setup/dispatch role with incomplete information.
Mara is managing a repair-and-sort workflow and relies on timely updates about parts and tool checks from others.

events.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Uli? Do you need a hand with anything?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Uli: It’s going, thanks for asking. I could use help sorting a few things, if you’ve got a moment.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mina: Sure — what do you want me to sort first?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — let me just double-check the details first, and I’ll confirm with you soon.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Great, thanks — can you let me know as soon as you confirm?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Mina: Great — start with the loose shelf near the entrance, and I’ll grab the tools.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Oren: Got it — the loose shelf near the entrance. I’ll start on that, and if I wander off, just give me a quick reminder.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Mina: Sure — what do you want me to sort first?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Jules: Let’s start with the repair tasks around the school pickup window, then I’ll line up the people and tools we need.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mina: Okay — send me the repair tasks list, and I’ll sort the school pickup window first.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Sam—do you need a hand with anything?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — yes, a hand would help a lot. Could you sort the donated items and set aside anything that needs tools or spare parts?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll sort the donated items and pull out anything that needs tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mina: Hey Noah, are we still good for the repair drive this weekend? Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Noah: Yep, still good — I just need the details on the first fix. Let me know where to start and I’ll do my best not to miss it.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mina: Great — start with the loose shelf near the entrance, and I’ll grab the tools.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll send you the repair tasks list next, and I’ll make sure the school pickup window stays first on the schedule.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mina: Great — send the list over, and I’ll help sort the first fixes for the pickup window.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Jules: Will do — I’m sending the list now, and I’ll keep the pickup window at the top.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Opal: Will do — I’m still locking in the drop-off spot and street coverage, then I’ll send the details along.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Mina: Sounds good — send the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll take the first fix or coverage spot.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Opal: Perfect — I’m nailing down the drop-off spot and coverage now, then I’ll send you the details.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Mara: Got it — I’m still sorting the donated items and setting aside the tool jobs and anything needing spare parts. If you’ve got updates or parts lists, send them my way.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got a couple of updates, and I can help with the first tool job. Just tell me what you need checked first.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — please start with the first tool job and check for any missing parts. If you spot anything odd, send me the update right away.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still in — just point me to the first fix and I’ll get on it.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mina: Great — start with the leaky faucet in the kitchen. I’ll point you to the next one after that.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll start with the kitchen faucet now. Just let me know what’s next after that.
events.speaker: Noah
